gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end) is a struck zero in all three columns. Chain: 0 beginning + 5138.40 over-$50 + 20.00 aggregate - 5158.40 expenses = 0.00 — closes EXACTLY against the printed ending balance. LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE also holds on lines 1, 2 and 3. This filer has only one filing in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain was available.

escalation_note: p2 name column and amount column re-rendered at 600 dpi; the row-1 donor initial re-rendered at 1200 dpi twice against the writer's own R (in 'Cache-Rich'/'Realtors') and L (in 'Michael L.') samples and still would not settle (see that row's note). p3 amount column re-rendered at 600 dpi in two 11-row bands and the vendor/purpose columns at 450 dpi in two bands. ROW 16 IS A RHODES-CLASS CASE: its cents pair reads '60' at 200 dpi and at 450 dpi (i.e. 1398.60), but at 1200 dpi the two glyphs are identical narrow ovals matching this writer's zero (compare 390.00, 195,00) and unlike his 6 (compare 326.15, 163.73, 56.69) — and the arithmetic is decisive: only 1398.00 makes the 22 rows sum to the 5158.40 printed on the cover AND hand-written by the filer (1398.60 would give 5159.00). ARITHMETIC RULED; transcribed 1398.00.
